title: Topology on a stable lattice
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pod-profinite-stable-lattice, for a finitely generated full free stable lattice Lambda, the maximal-ideal-adic topology equals the subspace topology and the restricted action is continuous.

proof.text: Use an integral basis to identify Lambda with a finite product of O_E and compare neighborhood bases; restrict the ambient continuous action.
